name: addpipe16_carry_skip4
rationale: Every hand-built parallel-prefix/CLA/carry-select variant tried so far computes ALL internal carries via wide flat SOP or iterative doubling, and each one landed below the plain native '+' baseline in WNS/reward while incurring extra area from wide AND-OR gates. This candidate tries a genuinely different structural class: a classic carry-skip adder (4 groups of 4 bits). Within each 4-bit group, carries are computed with a plain short ripple chain (cheap 2-input gates, like the area-optimal ripple16 baseline), decoupling group-to-group carry propagation from the intra-group ripple by computing each group's carry-out directly as G_k | (P_k & Cin_k) -- a single OR-AND 'skip' stage fed by pre-computed (Cin-independent) group generate/propagate signals. This turns the 16-bit worst-case ripple chain (~15 sequential FA stages) into ~3 skip hops plus one 3-stage intra-group ripple tail (~6-7 stages), while keeping area much closer to ripple16 than to the flat-SOP/CLA/prefix designs (no wide multi-term AND-OR merge networks beyond simple 4-input group G/P terms). This should land as a new non-dominated point: notably better WNS than ripple16 at much lower area than the ripple_prefix/select hybrids already on the frontier, plausibly improving the area/WNS Pareto frontier even if it does not beat the absolute best proxy_reward.
